blocks.text: The heading in verse 23, “These also are sayings of the wise,” signals that the material in verses 23–34 belongs with a distinct collection of wise sayings. The received book of Proverbs contains several such collections. Greek Proverbs preserves interpretive expansions and places portions corresponding to the Hebrew book’s final collections in a different order, so the arrangement of these sayings has been understood differently in ancient textual tradition.

The larger sequence leading up to Proverbs 24:22 has unusually close parallels in themes and expressions with the Egyptian Instruction of Amenemope. This proposed relationship is disputed, but it situates the sayings immediately before this final section alongside another ancient wisdom instruction.
